---
title: "Billboard Hot 100"
execute:
  echo: false
---
```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv")
summary(billboard$date.entered)

billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = week,
    y = rank,
    group = interaction(artist, track)
  )) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard Hot 100 song rankings over time",
    x = "Week on chart",
    y = "Ranking"
  )

weekly_ranks <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank"
  )

song_summary <- weekly_ranks |>
  filter(!is.na(rank)) |>
  group_by(artist, track) |>
  summarise(
    first_rank = first(rank),
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_week_at_best_rank = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    total_weeks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

notable_songs <- bind_rows(
  song_summary |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    slice_min(first_week_at_best_rank, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    mutate(notable = "Fastest to number one"),
  song_summary |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    slice_max(first_week_at_best_rank, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    mutate(notable = "Slowest to number one"),
  song_summary |>
    filter(best_rank <= 10) |>
    slice_max(total_weeks, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    mutate(notable = "Longest chart run among top-10 songs")
) |>
  select(notable, artist, track, first_rank, best_rank,
         first_week_at_best_rank, total_weeks)

print(notable_songs, width = Inf)

top_10_ranks <- weekly_ranks |>
  semi_join(
    song_summary |> filter(best_rank <= 10),
    by = c("artist", "track")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    notable_songs |>
      transmute(
        artist,
        track,
        notable_song = paste(artist, track, sep = " — ")
      ),
    by = c("artist", "track")
  )

top_10_ranks |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = week,
    y = rank,
    group = interaction(artist, track)
  )) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(top_10_ranks, is.na(notable_song)),
    color = "gray70",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(top_10_ranks, !is.na(notable_song)),
    aes(color = notable_song),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard Hot 100 top-10 song rankings",
    x = "Week on chart",
    y = "Ranking",
    color = "Notable songs"
  )
```
